governing_rule: The selected future event, its executable artifact, its witness consequences, the complete grounded distinction table, packaging, disclosure, and deadline are one global treatment-free causal chain before either arm gains access.
global_sequence: select exactly one first-qualifying release under A/G
bind its exact version string and selected candidate ID
resolve exactly one official linux-x64-glibc CLI artifact under FUTURE_EXECUTION_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT
if artifact is identified, run the same executable twice on each of the six frozen witness filesystems; otherwise mark all six witness consequences NOT_IDENTIFIED
derive all three frozen grounding-unit statuses and all twelve deterministic relation-kind lifts

create one canonical GroundingEnvelope containing event identity, artifact status/hashes, six consequence statuses/hashes, three grounding rows, twelve surfaces, kernel-domain adjudication, and contract digests
content-address the envelope before arm access
commit one common bundle containing the common obligation descriptor plus exactly that envelope
disclose the same bundle object at the same time with the same deadline to both arms
temporal_contract: t_freeze < t_select <= t_artifact_resolve <= t_ground <= t_grounding_commit <= t_bundle_commit < t_disclose < t_deadline

common_obligation_descriptor.semantics: identifies the single external event only; it does not contain A/B or reachability information

artifact_failure_semantics: If the exact frozen artifact rule cannot identify an executable, the selected release is not replaced. The GroundingEnvelope carries NOT_IDENTIFIED consequences/grounding statuses and the first endpoint cannot claim a kernel inclusion or generativity result from missing evidence.
automatic_fail: artifact version differs from the A/G selected release version
a source build or platform fallback is used
artifact or grounding logic receives treatment/Gamma/arm input
not all six witnesses are processed or retained as NOT_IDENTIFIED
not all three grounding units or all twelve path surfaces are packaged
a favorable grounded subset is selected
one arm accesses the event, artifact, grounding rows, or envelope before global commitment
bundle disclosure time or deadline differs across arms
a later release substitutes for the selected event
